en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wooded landscape with a manor-like building partly hidden by trees on a hill. In the foreground there is a small waterway or pond with a low dam and stone walls, as well as some outbuildings and stacked wood. Printed red text at the top identifies the location as Klingenberg near Dresden and mentions a Rittergut (manor estate). On the left edge, vertical publisher information is printed.
